#
# ubootEnv.txt - TaishanPi-3 RK3576 Dynamic Device Tree Overlay Configuration
#
# This file is read by U-Boot at boot time to load device tree overlays.
# Overlay .dtbo files must be placed in /boot/overlays/ on the board.
#
# Syntax:
#   overlays=file1.dtbo file2.dtbo   (space-separated, multiple on one line)
#   overlays=file1.dtbo              (or one per line, both styles work)
#   # Lines starting with '#' are comments and are ignored.
#
# After editing this file, reboot the board to apply changes.
#
#*********************************************************************


# ============================================================
# MINI-PCIe Slot Configuration
#
# The MINI-PCIe slot supports three mutually exclusive modes.
# Uncomment EXACTLY ONE of the three lines below.
# Loading more than one at a time will cause hardware conflicts.
#
#   Hardware mapping:
#     PCIe  mode : combphy0_ps -> PCIe0 controller
#     mSATA mode : combphy0_ps -> SATA0 controller
#     EC20  mode : GPIO-controlled modem (no combphy0_ps needed)
#
#   GPIO conflict warning:
#     PCIe and EC20 share GPIOs.
#     Never enable both overlays simultaneously.
# ============================================================

# Mode 1: Standard MINI-PCIe card
# overlays=tspi-3m-minipcie-pcie.dtbo

# Mode 2: mSATA SSD
# overlays=tspi-3m-minipcie-sata.dtbo

# Mode 3: Quectel EC20 4G LTE modem
# overlays=tspi-3m-minipcie-ec20.dtbo


# ============================================================
# MIPI DSI Display Configuration
#
# Uncomment the line matching your screen model.
# Only one DSI screen can be active at a time.
# ============================================================

# LCKFB-TSPI-10.1inch-MIPI-TP  (800x1280, LCSC: C41409463)
# overlays=tspi-3m-dsi-c41409463.dtbo

# LCKFB-mipi-3.1inch-screen    (480x800,  LCSC: C42388916)
# overlays=tspi-3m-dsi-c42388916.dtbo
